scenes.heading: Review your dashboards weekly and drop dead weight

sents.d: Review your dashboards weekly and drop dead weight
A quick weekly check stops you wasting time on products nobody buys.
Every hour spent on a product nobody buys is an hour lost.
Without a regular check, dead products eat your time for months.
Review clicks and sales for each product once a week.
If something gets clicks but no sales for a few weeks, replace it with a better option.

take: Check weekly, cut what doesn't sell, and give your winners more attention.
